cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Club Vistara card with IDFC providing CV Points on flight bookings, milestone vouchers, and travel perks for frequent flyers.

mileStoneItems.benefits: Earn up to 6000 Maharaja Points by spending minimum 30,000 every month for 3 applicable billing cycles.Billing statement for month 2, 3 and 4 from date of joining (Spend 30K and earn 2000 Maharaja Points per month).
